attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Commitment to enact a Teacher Protection Act to protect educators from meritless federal lawsuits.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to extend similar protections to non-profit organizations—churches, civic and community groups, and their volunteers.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to reform medical malpractice law on the federal level to reduce health care costs and keep doctors practicing in critical areas like obstetrics.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Recommendation to urge decisive action on the state level to reform medical malpractice law.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Recommendation to enact a Fair Settlements Rule requiring a party in federal court who rejects a timely, reasonable, and good faith pre-trial settlement offer, and who ultimately loses their case, to pay the other party's costs, including legal fees.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Recommendation to encourage states to consider enacting a Fair Settlements Rule requiring a party who rejects a timely, reasonable, and good faith pre-trial settlement offer, and who ultimately loses their case, to pay the other party's costs, including legal fees.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Recommendation to make it easier for cases of national import to be heard in federal courts to improve access to justice.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
